Technologiereuzen domineren vaak de markt, waardoor kleinere bedrijven het moeilijk hebben.

chinese: 他的性格如此强势,以至于主导了整个讨论。
科技巨头经常主导市场,使小公司陷入困境。
english: His personality is so dominant that he dominated the entire discussion.
Tech giants often dominate the market, making it difficult for smaller companies.

words.notes: 规则动词

examples: De medische doorbraak in de kankerbehandeling hoop op miljoenen levens te redden.
Na jaren van onderzoek deden ze een doorbaak in de vecht tegen infectieziekten.

chinese: 癌症治疗方面的医学突破有望拯救数百万人的生命。
经过多年的研究,他们在抗击传染病方面取得了突破。
english: The medical breakthrough in cancer treatment hopes to save millions of lives.
After years of research, they achieved a breakthrough in the fight against infectious diseases.

words.notes: 复数形式为 doorbraken（-aa 变 -a）

examples: Het is belangrijk om doordachte beslissingen te nemen in plaats van impulsief te handelen.
Het plan is zorgvuldig doordacht, met aandacht voor alle mogelijke risico's.

chinese: 重要的是要做出深思熟虑的决定,而不是冲动行事。
该计划经过深思熟虑,考虑到了所有可能的风险。
english: It is important to make thoughtful decisions instead of acting impulsively.
The plan is carefully thought out, with attention for all possible risks.

words.notes: 比较级和最高级规则：doordacht - doordachter - doordachst

examples: Omdat de kinderen op school zitten, werkt zijn moeder doordeweeks.
De files zijn doordeweeks veel rustiger dan in het weekend.

chinese: 因为孩子们在学校,他的母亲在工作日工作。
工作日时交通比周末安静得多。
english: Because the children are at school, his mother works on weekdays.
The traffic is much quieter during weekdays than in the weekend.

words.notes: 副词，表示工作日

examples: Het zonlicht dringt door de gordijnen en verlicht de kamer.
De nieuwe ideeën hebben langzaam door gedrongen tot de top van de organisatie.

chinese: 阳光透过窗帘照进房间,照亮了空间。
新想法已经慢慢渗透到组织的最高层。
english: The sunlight penetrates through the curtains and illuminates the room.
The new ideas have gradually penetrated to the top of the organization.

words.notes: 可分动词，助动词用zijn

examples: Er is vrije doorgang voor hulpdiensten bij noodsituaties.
Het project zorgt voor een duidelike doorgang tussen de verschillende afdelingen.

chinese: 紧急情况下有自由通道供救援服务使用。
该项目确保了各部门之间的明确沟通渠道。
english: There is free passage for emergency services in emergency situations.
The project ensures clear access between the various departments.

words.notes: 不可数名词

examples: We gaan doorheen de historische binnenstad om de bezienswaardigheid te bekijken.
De toerist wandelt doorheen de verschillende regio's van het land.

chinese: 我们要穿过历史悠久的市中心,欣赏风景名胜。
这个游客徒步穿过该国的不同地区。
english: We go through the historical city center to see the sights.
The tourist walks through the different regions of the country.

words.notes: 介词，与名词连用
